children: Benchmark and longer-dated Treasury yields continue to push higher after yesterday's big surge.
The move is mirrored across developed nations' debt, with Japanese, French and U.K. bond yields all strengthening.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
